name: Active Campaign
shortInfo: ActiveCampaign is a sales automation and CRM platform that helps sales teams growth.
brief: Active Campaign helps you automate all of the marketing tasks — engaging with customers via email and SMS, tracking customer relationships and much more.
about:
The Active Campaign Connector lets you sync data from the Active Campaign API automatically into your data warehouse.

Check more about Active Campaign api documentation [here](https://developers.activecampaign.com/reference/overview).
availableData:
[Accounts](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/active-campaign/pipelines/accounts.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of all existing accounts.

[Account Contacts Association](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/active-campaign/pipelines/account-contacts-association.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of all existing account- contact associations.

[Contacts](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/active-campaign/pipelines/contacts.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of all existing contacts in your ActiveCampaign account.
